observations_after_inspection: The unsealed road winds through the valley: across the foreground, then along the lower part of the left-hand slope, bending with the valley.
Steep, rocky slopes rise above it on both sides; the road keeps to the lower, gentler parts instead of climbing straight over them.
The photograph cannot show the exact gradient, the building cost or the full reason the road was placed here.
independent_solution: route follows the valley floor / lower slopes (1)
